results.content:
A Reuters/Ipsos poll released Aug. 31 found that 33% of Americans approved of Trump’s job performance, marking the third consecutive week at that level.

The 33% rating was Trump’s lowest in Reuters/Ipsos polling since he returned to the White House in 2025. It also matched his lowest approval rating during his first term, which came in December 2017.

The latest national figure was also below former President Joe Biden’s lowest approval rating, which reached 35% in October 2024. [...] # Trump approval rating slips among Alabama voters, new poll finds

Trump’s slip in the most recent poll comes as his approval among Republicans also dropped by two percentage points to 72%, marking a new low, according to the Financial Times. [...] # Trump approval rating reaches new record low in latest poll
